_comment: Single source of the HTTP security policy. Read by the backend at startup (backend/app/adapters/inbound/http/security.py); frontend/scripts/deploy-headers.mjs turns it into deploy/security-headers.caddy. The SHA-256 of the inline <head> script is appended to script-src at runtime/build. "hsts": Strict-Transport-Security, always sent by Caddy (browsers ignore it over plain HTTP) and by the backend only with ENABLE_HSTS=1. Gradual rollout: start at max-age=300; after a week of stable HTTPS raise it to max-age=31536000 (never add includeSubDomains/preload unless every subdomain is HTTPS), then rebuild (npm run build) so deploy/security-headers.caddy picks it up.
